latest_release.name: v12.5.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: configurable SAML attribute mapping for user ID, email and names by @supertokens-agent-runner[bot] in https://github.com/supertokens/supertokens-core/pull/1506
* fix: skip the backfill cron when migrated and store imported timeJoined 0 as 1 by @tamassoltesz in https://github.com/supertokens/supertokens-core/pull/1508
* ci: release tags — never publish a release without its tag, never delete a tag before moving it, leave unreleased plugin tags alone by @tamassoltesz in https://github.com/supertokens/supertokens-core/pull/1509
* feat: add disable_user_id_mapping to skip user id mapping lookups by @supertokens-agent-runner[bot] in https://github.com/supertokens/supertokens-core/pull/1494
* chore: merge integration/12.4-next into 12.5 for the 12.5.0 release by @tamassoltesz in https://github.com/supertokens/supertokens-core/pull/1514


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/supertokens/supertokens-core/compare/v12.4.3...v12.5.0
